title: First Draft: Trump Is Dangerously Unwell. So Why Are These Dems Helping Him?
author: Asawin Suebsaeng
content:
_On this day in 2020,[ a federal judge](https://www.npr.org/sections/live-
updates-protests-for-racial-justice/2020/07/23/894953202/order-temporarily-
blocks-feds-from-targeting-press-and-legal-observers-in-portla) in Portland
barred President Donald Trump's federal agents from targeting journalists and
legal observers, amid his crackdown on a U.S. city. Does this… sound
familiar?_

Happy Thursday, everyone. It's **Swin** and**Andrew** here. It's obvious our
current state of affairs is unsustainable.

The entire ruling party is propping up the personality cult and blundering
agenda of someone who is disturbed to the point he's willing to blow up the
world economy for no reason beyond his [own
spite](https://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/5981743-trump-canada-
wildfires-tariffs/) [and confusion](https://zeteo.com/p/bumbling-warmonger-
picks-worst-possible). Democrats, for their part, are not only struggling to
oppose **Donald Trump** or rein him in… some are outright doing his bidding.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we once again acknowledge the reality that the
president is deeply unwell and fundamentally unfit for office, while some
Democrats insist on helping him. Meanwhile, the president unveiled his plan
for spiking drug prices, and **Jeffrey Epstein 's** model recruiter was just
found dead.

We've written here at **Zeteo** about how the sitting leader of the United
States is **" too dangerous, too unwell, too much of a fascist"** and **"[
must be removed from office](https://zeteo.com/p/time-for-trump-to-go)."** No
one with any power is trying to remove Donald Trump from office, but that does
not make it any less necessary: He is patently insane.

The president of the United States is trying to unilaterally impose new taxes
on the American people because he's mad at [Canada for being on
fire](https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/ontario-wildfires-expand-
smoke-lingers-parts-us-2026-07-20/). He is [angrily threatening war
crimes](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/22/world/live-news/the-war-with-iran) and
re-escalating his war in Iran [at the worst possible time for the global
economy](https://zeteo.com/p/bumbling-warmonger-picks-worst-possible) - _even
though he knows the war is[ politically destroying
him](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/07/22/poll-maga-souring-iran-war-
costs-trump-01006976), his party, and his administration_.

He is now ranting on social media about how voters should be _grateful_ that
his disastrous war [has only gotten 18 Americans
killed](https://newrepublic.com/post/213357/donald-trump-tries-claim-dead-
troops-iran-good-thing). He's still
[suggesting](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2080019280138023188) he wants to run
for an unconstitutional third term, and
[claiming](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2080023499112857762) now that **"
communists"** want to **" blow up"** Mount Rushmore.

Every day Trump is in power is a unique, extreme crisis, one that threatens
the lives and safety of an incalculable number of people,
[both](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-cant-quit-his-failing-campaign)
[here](https://zeteo.com/p/trumps-violent-crackdowns-on-us-cities) [and
abroad](https://zeteo.com/p/iran-humiliates-trump-again-as-his). And yet, some
Democrats keep trying to give this man more power and more money, and expand
his ability to threaten our democracy.
